text:
Zara: Two huge life updates in one tiny message: engaged! 💍 and accepted the Lead Platform role (starts May). Also we're planning a cross-country move to SF in June . Low-key celebration Friday at 4pm in the kitchen? No pressure, just hugs.
Ben: WHOA! Congrats on all of it!!! :tada: I can bring a charcuterie board and help with moving boxes.
Mei: This is the best news. Engagement ring photo pls 
Zara: Ring photo incoming 48d (posting after work). Thank you!!
Connor: Massive congrats. Lead Platform is huge, you earned it. If you need help with SF logistics (neighborhood recs, movers) I'll DM you.
Hannah: I'll bring cupcakes and make a little "Congrats Zara" sign. Also free babysitting? (jk) :joy:
OpsBot: Reminder: kitchen booking at 16:00 on Fri reserved by Zara. Please label perishables.
MoveBot: Tip: For cross-country moves, schedule movers ~6 weeks in advance. Recommended vendors: PackRight, SmoothTransit (internal discount code saved).
Ben: Also happy to coordinate a small group to help move big stuff weekend of June 12th if that works.
Mei: We should get a tiny registry link for the team card? I can set up a Google Form for messages.
Zara: Registry link later (no pressure). Card would be lovely. Thanks for the move help offer60a June 12th could work.
Connor: For SF neighborhoods, Priorities? commute vs walkability vs plants? I can send a short pros/cons doc.
Hannah: Song rec for celebration playlist: "Home" by Edward Sharpe & the Magnetic Zeros. Also bringing a plant for your new place.
Zara: Commuting balance is key for me. Connor, send recs when you have time. And thank you everyone 970970. See you Friday 4pm!
